summary: Completed frontend testing of Kiosk Mode OTP verification flow. All core OTP verification features work correctly. Found one permission issue with Resend OTP functionality.

minor.issue: Kiosk volunteers cannot resend OTP - endpoint uses require_organizer_access which excludes KIOSK_VOLUNTEER role
minor.fix_suggestion: Change resend_otp endpoint to use require_kiosk_access instead of require_organizer_access in offline_payment_routes.py line 762

action_items: Fix Resend OTP permission: Change line 762 in /app/backend/offline_payment_routes.py from 'require_organizer_access' to 'require_kiosk_access' (import from kiosk_routes)
critical_code_review_comments: The resend_otp endpoint should allow kiosk volunteers to resend OTP since they're at the registration desk helping users who may have lost their OTP
context_for_next_testing_agent: Kiosk Mode OTP verification flow is working correctly. Test results: 1) Wrong OTP (000000) shows error 'The OTP entered is incorrect', 2) Correct OTP (422711) shows success and proceeds to payment, 3) Users without OTP skip OTP step and go directly to payment. One issue: Resend OTP button returns 403 for kiosk volunteers due to permission check.

otp_verification_wrong_otp.test: Enter wrong OTP (000000) for OTP TestUser
otp_verification_wrong_otp.actual: Error message 'The OTP entered is incorrect. Please try again.' shown + toast 'Invalid OTP'

otp_verification_correct_otp.test: Enter correct OTP (422711) for OTP TestUser
otp_verification_correct_otp.actual: Toast 'OTP verified successfully!', 'OTP Verified' badge shown, payment section visible

otp_skip_for_no_otp_user.test: Select user without OTP (Kiosk Test Backend)
otp_skip_for_no_otp_user.expected: OTP step skipped, payment section shown directly
otp_skip_for_no_otp_user.actual: No OTP step shown, payment section visible immediately

resend_otp.test: Click Resend OTP button for OTP TestUser
resend_otp.actual: Error 403 - 'Organizer access required (Super Admin, Director, or Org Admin)'
resend_otp.note: Kiosk volunteer role not allowed to resend OTP
